scientific_role: define a response-independent annual survey-support surface before any species detection, nondetection, occupancy, source-loss event or t2 outcome is opened

official_sampling_event_source.access_semantics: downloaded through the official eBird Basic Dataset data-request workflow by a logged-in user

island_geometry.publication: Sayre et al. global islands 30-m shoreline-derived polygon database
island_geometry.coordinate_reference: geometry is transformed to EPSG:4326 before checklist mapping
island_geometry.zero_polygon_matches: exclude checklist from island-year support and count as outside_geometry
island_geometry.multiple_polygon_matches: exclude checklist as ambiguous and count separately
island_geometry.dryad_crosswalk: future species rows use ISLAND_ID corresponding to Sayre OBJECTID

checklist_deduplication.eligible_first: retain only ALL SPECIES REPORTED=TRUE rows before survey-support aggregation
checklist_deduplication.event_key: nonblank GROUP IDENTIFIER defines one shared sampling event; blank GROUP IDENTIFIER uses SAMPLING EVENT IDENTIFIER
checklist_deduplication.shared_group_count: a repeated nonblank GROUP IDENTIFIER contributes at most one survey event
checklist_deduplication.canonical_representative: lexicographically smallest SAMPLING EVENT IDENTIFIER within the event key
checklist_deduplication.conflicting_group_date: exclude the entire shared group from annual survey support
checklist_deduplication.conflicting_group_coordinates: exclude the entire shared group if latitude or longitude differs by more than 1e-6 degrees among members

annual_survey_quality_rule.rationale: pre-response effort and temporal-support rule anchored to eBird completeness literature: fewer than 10 checklists has been treated as low support, and four sampled months is a documented minimum temporal-support criterion; this is a survey-support proxy, not a replication of the published species-accumulation completeness estimator
annual_survey_quality_rule.reason_no_effort_cutoffs: avoid choosing hard effort thresholds before seeing the response-independent SED support surface; valid effort variables are retained for later frozen reference adjustment instead of outcome-informed filtering

next_gate: after v1.149 metadata audit and this v1.154 survey-surface build both succeed, freeze deterministic eligible-island and three-wave pilot/confirmatory window selection from survey support only; species outcomes remain sealed
anti_selection: do not lower 10-checklist or 4-month minima after species outcomes are opened
do not select years because source-loss or persistence effects look favourable
do not infer absences from the Dryad observed-species archive before this survey surface is frozen
do not assign offshore points to their nearest island
do not inspect species identity to resolve ambiguous geometry
do not use BALA non-support to choose a more favourable eBird threshold
